description: Add coordinated buy detection to OnchainAnalyzer + Tavily X search integration with new XSearchClient module. Integrate both into scanner.py pipeline.
steps: Add detect_coordinated_buys method to OnchainAnalyzer in onchain.py
Integrate coordinated buys into check_token method and safe_score
Update scanner.py pipeline to include coordinated buy rejection and X search integration
Update format_telegram_message to include X search info
Create tests for coordinated buys and X search
Run all tests and verify build
acceptance_criteria: detect_coordinated_buys returns has_bundled_pattern, cluster_count, cluster_pct_of_supply, coordinated_risk
3-4 clustered wallets = MEDIUM risk, 5+ = HIGH risk, >20% supply = HIGH regardless
HIGH risk: safe_score -= 25, MEDIUM risk: safe_score -= 10
Scanner rejects tokens with coordinated_risk == HIGH
XSearchClient searches Tavily with include_domains x.com
X search returns status, result_count, accounts, scam_warning, big_account_mention, has_buzz, top_snippet
X info displayed in Telegram message
X_DATA_NOT_FOUND is not treated as scam signal
findings: All 290 tests pass (239 existing + 51 new). detect_coordinated_buys reuses existing largest_accounts data from check_token to avoid duplicate RPC calls. Cluster detection uses 5% tolerance on raw integer amounts, excluding holder #1 (LP). XSearchClient uses httpx with 15s timeout. Scanner pipeline: Fetch -> Twitter -> Serial Deployer -> Age -> DEX -> Rug -> On-chain (incl. coordinated buys) -> X Search -> Wave -> P(2x) -> Alert. Coordinated HIGH = reject. Scam warning + MEDIUM+ coordinated = reject. big_account_mention boosts P(2x) x1.3, has_buzz boosts x1.15. X_DATA_NOT_FOUND is NOT treated as scam.
